evidence: Renames ParseHDKeypath in src/util/bip32.h and src/util/bip32.cpp and expands its test coverage in src/test/bip32_tests.cpp.
rationale: Strengthens unit test assertions for ParseHDKeypath by checking parsed numeric keypaths and round-trip string formatting instead of only checking return booleans. Because this legacy helper is superseded and limited to legacy wallet loading, the improvement is marginal.
